description: Balanced-detail Codex guide. Twelve rounded hand parts reduced by half; source-traced glyph, shell, forearms, skin and twelve clips retained. Internal production asset.

provenance.author: Mark Kashef project, authored with Codex
provenance.prompt: Use the supplied Codex logo as the personified guide to a high-quality educational tour through the Codex ecosystem.
provenance.negativePrompt: Do not invent another logo or distort the original glyph; no paid provider generation.
provenance.notes: Source raster is game/public/assets/codex-reference.png, hash retained in art-source/glyph-contours.json. Source authoring and all actions are preserved in art-source/codex-mascot-traced-glyph-v4.blend. Export is normalized only by promoting identity-transform skinned nodes; full binary payload is preserved at that normalization stage. Material design uses vertex color and PBR constants, so image textures/UVs are not required by this asset policy. Package integrity is separate from source-logo rights and final release approval. Balanced master: art-source/codex-mascot-balanced.blend. Only twelve rounded hand meshes receive a 0.5 collapse decimation. Static validation preserves all animation and bind data; five unchanged meshes have byte-identical primitive arrays. GLB SHA256: 07785f58bbebd6fbb48543542d409c6deca5cb0a0651bab8657419933ee764ee.
